app.name: FORM
app.subtitle: Your training, thoughtfully planned.
app.welcomeBody: Tell your coach what you have available. Your plan stays on this device.
app.errorBody: The app could not read or save your local data. If your data is available, export a backup from Settings.
app.notice: Your data is stored only in this browser. Back it up regularly, especially on iPhone.

home.title:
Make today
count.
home.description: A plan shaped around your strength, your equipment, and the time you have.
home.noSessions: Your first session is one tap away.
home.trainingNote: Take it at your pace. Your coach learns from every session you complete.

generator.focusPlaceholder: e.g. pull strength, legs, full body

runner.finishBody: Every rep is progress. Take a moment to log how it felt.
runner.sessionNote: Anything to remember for next time?

history.title:
Progress,
not perfection.
history.description: Small steps add up. Your past sessions help shape what comes next.
history.emptyTitle: Your story starts with one session.
history.emptyBody: Complete a workout to see your progress take shape.
history.noData: Log this movement in a few sessions to see a trend.

settings.title:
Make it
yours.
settings.description: Your coach works best when it knows your setup.
settings.apiKeyHelp: Your key stays in this browser and is sent only to api.openai.com when you generate a workout. Anyone with access to this device can use it. Never share exported backups that contain your key.
settings.modelHelp: Model name is sent directly to OpenAI. Default: gpt-5.4-mini.
settings.stylePlaceholder: I enjoy steady progress, short rests, and a mix of strength and mobility…
settings.styleHelp: A few words help the coach choose a style that feels like yours.
settings.capabilitiesDescription: Add a movement and your current best. This guides your coach’s starting point.
settings.noCapabilities: No movements added yet. You can still build a plan; the coach will start conservatively.
settings.persistentUnsupported: This browser does not offer persistence status
settings.backupInfo: Backups include your profile, workouts, progress, and settings. Your API key is left out unless you choose to include it.
settings.dataError: Could not save that change. Your previous data is still in place.
settings.invalidBackup: This file is not a valid AI Gym Coach backup.

install.title: Keep your training close
install.body: Safari may remove website data after a period of inactivity. Add FORM to your Home Screen to keep its storage separate from Safari and easier to return to.
install.step1: Tap the Share button in Safari.
install.step3: Open FORM from its new Home Screen icon. Safari and the installed app keep separate data.
install.reminder: It’s been a while since your last backup. Export your training data to keep a copy safe.
